summary: Independent Luna security review found the offline verifier can accept modified authority values, leak uncaught filesystem errors, trust unsafe root ancestors, ignore undeclared privileged artifacts, and lacks acceptance-critical adversarial coverage.
validation: Exact PR head 1b7dca9a338b65e1a305988f91a01f1d680f1be1 reviewed against base efb9faac0606e02b7cac8e36e716f1ede9a50fb6.
All four added files reviewed against the six-requirement pipeline spec.
Existing eight tests are insufficient to exercise positive real-state fixtures and critical drift/ancestor/extra-artifact cases.
blockers: Executable validation must enforce reviewed immutable IDs, metadata, revisions, and exact digests rather than shapes only.
All root canonicalization, stat, race, permission, and Unicode failures must map to deterministic sanitized reason codes.
No-follow ownership/mode/symlink checks must cover the snapshot root and complete root-to-target chain.
Privileged directories must be inventoried for undeclared artifacts with explicit bounded exceptions.
Tests must add positive fixtures and one mutation case for every required identity, state, filesystem, sudo, and cleanup attack class.
next_action: Return to Luna code owner for focused remediation of REV-1290-001 through REV-1290-005, then independently re-review the new exact head.

issues.title: Immutable authority values are not enforced
issues.details: IDs, host metadata, source/upstream revisions, and digests accept arbitrary shaped replacements; identity/workflow checks are no-ops.

issues.title: Filesystem errors can escape sanitized evidence
issues.details: Root resolve/stat and repeated workspace stat paths can raise uncaught errors or race outside bounded ContractError handling.

issues.title: Root and ancestor trust validation is incomplete
issues.details: Symlinked or attacker-owned ancestors above the snapshot root can be accepted; use no-follow complete-chain checks.

issues.title: Undeclared privileged artifacts are not detected
issues.details: Verifier checks declared paths only and does not inventory privileged directories for unexpected helpers or sudo policies.

issues.title: Adversarial suite misses critical acceptance paths
issues.details: Add positive fixture and identity, revision, digest, service, ownership, root/ancestor, extra-file, traversal, shell, environment, and cleanup mutations.
